description: This file provides the implementation of DefaultGatewaySignalEnrichmentConfig, a final class that encapsulates configuration settings for gateway signal enrichment, including cache configuration, timeout durations, and enabling flags. It includes methods for creating instances from a Config object, retrieving configuration values, rendering the configuration, and overriding standard Object methods.
